description: Polytab Futarchy Policy Markets (Pilot). Vote on values, forecast with pennies. Every stake is a direct donation: 100% of it reaches the escrow of the intervention the staker chose. There is no protocol fee, no pooled pot, no redistribution between outcomes, and no payout of any kind to any staker. Settlement only decides which intervention earns the documented-improvement credit, and which forecasters earn non-monetary accuracy credit (public accuracy rate, resolution record, badges). All markets launch at $0 funded with an unset forecast split; numbers appear only after verified on-chain stakes.

fundingPolicy.description: 100% of every stake goes to the project escrow selected by the staker. Polytab never takes custody, never takes a cut, and never pays a staker back.

incentivePolicy.description: Forecast accuracy earns reputation only: a public accuracy rate, a win/loss record, and badges. Reputation is never redeemable, transferable, or paid in money.

markets.title: Futarchy Pilot: Which does more for Chicago children with disabilities by the end of the 2026-27 school year — early sensory/motor therapy, or accessible summer camp + power-wheelchair diagnostics?
markets.resolutionRule: Council compares verified program outcome evidence (clinical milestone logs, camp participation records, power-wheelchair fitting counts) plus Chicago Public Schools Office of Diverse Learners Supports published data. The intervention with the larger documented improvement in school participation and mobility independence for children with disabilities is credited with the better outcome.

oracle.settlement: Resolution posted as a public GitHub Issue with attached evidence. Any staker may challenge during the dispute window by posting a dispute bond. Final call by 2-of-3 multi-sig council including at least one directly impacted stakeholder (Nothing About Us Without Us).

markets.fundingRule: 100% of every stake goes directly to the escrow of the outcome the staker chose (#207 or #315 on the Action Shelf). No protocol slice, no shared pot, no redistribution to the other side, and no payout to any staker — the money only ever funds the chosen project.
markets.reputationRule: When the market resolves, stakers who backed the credited intervention earn a Correct Forecast credit: accuracy rate, win/loss record, and a public badge. Nothing is paid out; reputation is not redeemable or transferable.
markets.plainSummary:
• What is broken: Chicago families of children with disabilities must choose between therapy programs without real evidence about which one works better.
• What will be done: Two verified programs receive direct donations from people backing them. Small amounts reveal which program the community believes works better, and every dollar funds a real program.
• Incentive: people who forecast correctly earn a public accuracy score and badges — never money.
• Proof: The market resolves on published school-participation data and each program's audited clinical logs, posted to a public GitHub Issue with a 72-hour challenge window.

markets.title: Futarchy Pilot: Which improves measurable health outcomes more for Denver's low-income children by Q4 2027 — in-home nurse visits for first-time mothers, or therapeutic equine-assisted physical therapy for disabled children?

outcomes.label: In-Home Nurse Visits for First-Time Mothers

markets.resolutionRule: Council compares verified program outcome evidence (NFP home-visit completion and maternal/infant health indicators; PATH therapy goal-attainment scores and mobility milestones) plus Denver public health community reports. The intervention with the larger documented health improvement per program dollar is credited with the better outcome.
